premises: Plasma nitriding at 750 °C for 4 h in NH3:N2 (1:2) forms a ~2–3 μm TiN/Ti2N compound layer on Ti–6Al–4V
This nitride layer increases surface hardness by 2- to 2.5-fold (to 800–1000 HV) and improves wear resistance
Laser surface texturing with dimples further reduces friction and wear by acting as lubricant reservoirs and reducing contact area
The combined treatment yields ~5-fold wear reduction under 8 N pin-on-disk at room temperature
